# 03 — Temporal drift

The headline question: did the *centre of mass* of "what NetEase listeners
are into" move between 2020 and 2025, and if so, along which dimension?

```{r paths}
ROOT    <- normalizePath(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input()), "..", ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
FEA_FN  <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "embeddings", "song_features.csv")
SNAPS_RDS <- file.path(ROOT, "data", "embeddings", "all_snapshots.rds")
```
